question: The colossal monolithic statue of Gomateshwara at Shravanabelagola is carved out of a single block of _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**granite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The colossal monolithic statue of **Gomateshwara** at **Shravanabelagola** is one of the largest free-standing statues in the world.
 
• This statue is carved out of a single block of **granite**.
 
• The **Gomateshwara statue** stands at a height of approximately 57 feet.
 
• It was constructed around the year **981 AD**.
 
• The statue is dedicated to **Lord Bahubali**, a revered figure in Jainism.
 
• The site is an important pilgrimage destination for the Jain community and attracts numerous visitors from around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Marble**__

 __
 
• **Marble** is a metamorphic rock composed primarily of carbonate minerals, most commonly calcite or dolomite.
 
• It is highly valued for its use in sculpture and as a building material due to its beauty and durability.
 
• Famous structures made of marble include the **Taj Mahal** and **Michelangelo's David**.
 
 
 
• **Stone**__
 __
 
• In general terms, **stone** refers to any naturally occurring solid aggregate of minerals or mineraloid matter.
 
• Stones have been used throughout history for construction, tools, and decoration.
 
• Different types of stones include granite, marble, limestone, and sandstone.
 
 
 
• **Rock**__
 
 
• **Rock** is a naturally occurring solid mass or aggregate of minerals.
 
• Rocks are categorized into three main types: igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic.
 
• Granite, marble, and sandstone are all examples of different types of rocks.
